    Renting an apartment in New Gurgaon: Property market insights

    Browse apartments for rent in New Gurgaon where societies like Godrej Air, Landmark The Homes 81 and Smart World Gems are considered the most popular addresses right now. At present, there are 3692 apartments for rent available in New Gurgaon,out of which 554 are available without brokerage. For those looking for apartments for rent on an immediate basis, there are 2554 options available in 15 days or less. Other areas where you can search apartments for rent near New Gurgaon are Sector 36B Gurgaon, Sector 36A Gurgaon and Sihi Village

    How good is New Gurgaon in terms of connectivity?

    New Gurgaon has several transit points in proximity which ensures its inter-connectivity to nearby areas. Garhi harsaru junction railway station, is crucial for New Gurgaon connectivity.

    How is New Gurgaon neighborhood?

    For medical needs, some of the nearby hospitals are Shri Balaji Hospital and Trauma Center, S.R.S. Hospital and Critical Care Unit, etc. Most of the societies in New Gurgaon has amenities such as Lift, Gymnasium and Park, etc.

    Price Trends for apartments in New Gurgaon

    Currently, rent values in New Gurgaon are around ₹ 6000-155000 per month.
